summary: IHS Holding Ltd, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an Extraordinary General Meeting held August 4, 2026. Shareholders approved the merger agreement dated February 17, 2026, under which MTN Group (Parent) and Mobile Telephone Networks (Netherlands) B.V. (Holdings), through wholly owned Merger Sub, will merge Merger Sub with and into IHS Holding, with IHS as the surviving company. Of 264,066,813 shares represented, the special resolution was approved; the adjournment proposal was not called. This is a going-private transaction, as MTN already holds a controlling stake and seeks to acquire the remaining public shares. Board approval was noted, with the proxy statement filed on Schedule 13E-3. Watch for regulatory clearances and closing conditions to complete the squeeze-out.
